details: For every finite binary concept class, the combinatorial eluder dimension dominates threshold dimension. The singleton family gives an unbounded separation: $\mathrm{Edim}=n-1$ while threshold dimension is 1.
proof: A threshold-chain witness relative to its base hypothesis is a sequential eluder witness. This is the lower bound in Theorem 8 of the cited paper.
proof_source: Theorem 8 (the threshold-dimension lower bound) of Li--Kamath--Foster--Srebro.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Threshold Dimension
